citations.assessment: The midrash names Mani of She’av and Yehoshua of Sikhnin jointly, in the name of Levi. Preserve the form Mana in the heading.
This parallel again pairs Mani of She’av with Yehoshua of Sikhnin in Levi’s name. The Buber witness corroborates the pair with a different ordering of the four deaths’ explanations.

evidence.witness: Midrash Tanhuma haKadum veHaYashan, S. Buber, 1885
